title: Propast
role: Lead Level Designer and Game Designer
owned: World metrics, mission flow and level structure for a 12-person FPS team, plus the GDD and LDD, the encounter framework and the AI design direction. I lead three designers across level, game and environment design and stay hands-on in implementation.
brief: Shape the level structure and design direction of a 12-person FPS team, aiming at the publisher's one-hour demo brief.
problem: Turn research and 2D maps into a demo world that fits a one-hour brief, with combat built around AI, interactive destruction and physics props.
approach: I reworked the demo world from research and 2D maps through graybox and polish passes, built FPS encounters around AI, interactive destruction and physics props, and iterated on combat balance and environmental gameplay. I introduced system, feature and location briefs to guide junior and mid-level designers.
summary: Lead Level Designer and Game Designer on a 12-person Unreal Engine 5 FPS: world metrics, mission flow and encounter framework.
